description: Operation ids that have been removed from the canonical operation registry. Downstream HTTP / gRPC / MQ binding surfaces and SDK call sites MUST NOT advertise them. cotest scanner consumes this list to detect drift in implementation surfaces.

rejection_levels.hard_reject: MUST NOT appear in any current operation registry, OpenAPI document, gRPC schema, or SDK call site.
rejection_levels.migration_only: MAY appear in time-bounded migration adapters; new bindings MUST NOT add it.
rejection_levels.compat_only: Only on explicit interop / compatibility surfaces.
rejection_levels.docs_only: Removed from machine surfaces; survives in CHANGELOG / migration notes.

allowed_context_definitions.changelog: Reference in CHANGELOG or migration documentation.
allowed_context_definitions.legacy_migration: Reference in time-bounded migration adapter code.
allowed_context_definitions.interop_module: Reference in an explicit interop binding (not core).
allowed_context_definitions.negative_test: Reference in cotest drift fixtures that assert rejection.
